candidates.source_name: Athanasius of Alexandria / Epistulae ad Serapionem 1.6-7
candidates.source_attribution: Athanasius of Alexandria, Epistulae ad Serapionem de Spiritu Sancto (Letters to Serapion on the Holy Spirit, I-IV), in Select Writings and Letters of Athanasius, Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers (NPNF), Series 2, Vol. 4, ed. Archibald Robertson (Oxford / T&T Clark, 1892). PD. Greek text in Migne PG 26 (1857).
candidates.draft_body:
Athanasius of Alexandria Epistulae ad Serapionem 1.6-7 (c. 350 AD)

'But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth' — Athanasius marks dynamin epelthontos tou Hagiou Pneumatos eph' hymas (power-when-the-Holy-Spirit-has-come-upon you) as the apostolic-succession FORMULA: the same Spirit who-equipped-Christ-as-prophet (Lk 4:18 — Pneuma kyriou ep' eme) now equips the apostolic-Church-as-prophetic-body. The geographical-progression Jerusalem → Judea → Samaria → ends-of-earth is the Spirit's-economic-extension; the Tewahedo Church's foundation through the Ethiopian-eunuch (Acts 8:27-39 → Aksumite tradition) is in the same Spirit-economic-arc.
candidates.reviewer_notes: Curated PD interpretive summary representing the Ethiopian Tewahedo tradition's reading via Athanasius of Alexandria, Epistulae ad Serapionem 1.6-7. candidates.draft_body:
Athanasius of Alexandria Epistulae ad Serapionem 1.6-7 (c. 350 AD)

'But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth' — Athanasius marks dynamin epelthontos tou Hagiou Pneumatos eph' hymas (power-when-the-Holy-Spirit-has-come-upon you) as the apostolic-succession FORMULA: the same Spirit who-equipped-Christ-as-prophet (Lk 4:18 — Pneuma kyriou ep' eme) now equips the apostolic-Church-as-prophetic-body. The geographical-progression Jerusalem → Judea → Samaria → ends-of-earth is the Spirit's-economic-extension; the Tewahedo Church's foundation through the Ethiopian-eunuch (Acts 8:27-39 → Aksumite tradition) is in the same Spirit-economic-arc.
